user.title: Account
user.description: Choose your data provider and sign in. For ESO use your mano.eso.lt credentials; for Ignitis use your Ignitis "Energy Smart" (energy-smart-api.ignitis.lt) credentials.

data_description.provider: ESO (mano.eso.lt) uses an email two-factor code; Ignitis signs in directly without a mailbox.
data_description.username: Your provider username or email address.
data_description.password: Your account password. It is verified before continuing.

ignitis_auth.title: Ignitis login method
ignitis_auth.description: Choose how Home Assistant signs in to the Ignitis account {username}. Try "Direct" first. If it reports invalid credentials even though they are correct, switch to "Self sign portal", which reproduces the login the mobile app performs.

data_description.auth_type: Direct posts your credentials to the Energy Smart API. Self sign portal goes through e.ignitis.lt like the mobile app does.
data_description.password: Your Ignitis account password. It is verified with the selected login method before continuing.

imap.title: Two-factor authentication (email)
imap.description: ESO emails a one-time code on every login, so a mailbox is required. Enter the mailbox that receives those codes so Home Assistant can read them automatically. For Gmail you must create an App Password (https://support.google.com/accounts/answer/185833) — your normal password will not work.

data_description.imap_username: The mailbox login that receives ESO 2FA codes (e.g. your.name@gmail.com).
data_description.imap_password: Mailbox password. For Gmail/Google use an App Password, not your account password.
data_description.sender: Only emails from this address are searched for the code.

objects.title: Select objects
objects.description: These metering points (objects) were discovered on your account, named after their address. Choose which ones to track in Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconfigure ESO account
reauth_confirm.description: ESO now requires email two-factor authentication for {username}. Confirm your password and add the mailbox that receives the one-time codes. For Gmail use an App Password (https://support.google.com/accounts/answer/185833).

data_description.imap_username: The mailbox login that receives ESO 2FA codes.
data_description.imap_password: Mailbox password. For Gmail/Google use an App Password.
data_description.sender: Only emails from this address are searched for the code.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to your energy provider. Please try again.
error.imap_required: Mailbox username and password are required for two-factor authentication.
error.twofa_failed: Could not complete two-factor login. Check your mailbox (IMAP) settings and that the App Password is correct.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs for details.

abort.no_objects: No objects were found on this account.

init.title: Update credentials
init.description: Update the account password for {username}. ESO accounts can also update their mailbox (2FA) settings here. To use a different account, add a new integration entry instead.

data_description.auth_type: Ignitis only. Direct posts your credentials to the Energy Smart API; self sign portal goes through e.ignitis.lt like the mobile app does.
data_description.imap_username: The mailbox login that receives ESO 2FA codes.
data_description.imap_password: Mailbox password. For Gmail/Google use an App Password.
data_description.sender: Only emails from this address are searched for the code.

error.imap_required: Mailbox username and password are required for two-factor authentication.
error.twofa_failed: Could not complete two-factor login. Check your mailbox (IMAP) settings and that the App Password is correct.

user.title: Add object
user.description: Choose a metering point (object) discovered on your account to add. Each is named after its address.

data_description.name: Name shown in the energy dashboard.
data_description.consumed: Generate statistics for energy consumed from the grid.
data_description.returned: Generate statistics for energy returned to the grid.
data_description.price_entity: Optional sensor tracking electricity price; enables a cost statistic.
data_description.price_currency: Currency for the cost statistic (e.g. EUR).
data_description.fixed_price: Optional flat price per kWh, used for the cost statistic when no price entity is set.
data_description.export_balance: Track the export balance reported by Ignitis (no effect for ESO).

import_now.name: Import now
import_now.description: Signs in to your energy provider (ESO or Ignitis) and imports the latest consumption statistics on demand.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The account(s) to import. Leave empty to import all configured accounts.

date_from.name: Date from
date_from.description: Optional first day to import. Set it to backfill history instead of the usual daily window; supported by both ESO and Ignitis.

date_to.name: Date to
date_to.description: Optional last day of the backfill range (defaults to today). Requires date from. Ignitis publishes complete days only, so the range is clamped to yesterday.

confirm.title: Remove the ESO YAML configuration
confirm.description:
Configuring ESO via configuration.yaml is deprecated. Your existing configuration has been imported and the integration is now available under Settings → Devices & Services.

Remove the `eso:` block from configuration.yaml and restart Home Assistant, then submit to dismiss this issue.
